Official Milano Sensual Congress schedule, 20–22 November 2026: workshop timetables, shows, party times and dress codes at Devero Hotel near Milan.

Milano Sensual Congress · 20–22 November 2026

Workshops, shows and Bachata parties at Devero Hotel, Cavenago di Brianza, near Milan. Three rooms: Duomo, Navigli and San Babila.

### Tickets & access

Full Pass includes the parties and afternoon socials. Saturday afternoon also admits Saturday Day Pass holders. Full Social Pass includes Friday night, Saturday night and Sunday afternoon.

[See tickets and pass details →](https://milanosensualcongress.com/tickets)

### Music & venue

Friday and Saturday night: Duomo — Bachata, no remixes; Navigli — romantic Bachata, low BPM. Sunday afternoon: Duomo — no remixes.

Devero Hotel · Largo Kennedy 1, 20873 Cavenago di Brianza (MB), Italy.

[Venue and travel details →](https://milanosensualcongress.com/hotel)
